question.text: Which SDG corresponds to 'Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions'?

explanation.text: The Logic: SDG 16 is 'Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions'. SDG 13 is Climate Action, SDG 14 is Life Below Water, SDG 15 is Life on Land. The Trap: Options A, B and C are the environmental triad (13, 14, 15). SDG 16 is often forgotten in environmental-heavy mappings. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 6 (Frameworks) and Ch 8 (Case Studies) for governance-related SE programmes (RTI advocacy, right-to-education enforcement etc.). Assessor's Pro-Tip: SAS-400 governance & justice indicators map to SDG 16. When the SE works on advocacy (e.g., RTI, RTE, juvenile justice), index outputs to SDG 16.6 (accountable institutions) or 16.7 (participatory decision-making).
